design.inference_rule: average ordered pairs within state; hierarchical bootstrap suites then tasks then states
design.mechanical_fallback_rule: abort the entire launch before model inference if any task lacks any requested index
design.smoke_exclusion: indices 0,1,2,3 used by smoke are excluded from every powered task
design.state_selection_rule: Cartesian product of every suite, every task, and untouched initial-state indices 4,5,6
design.task_structure: 40 tasks nested within four LIBERO suites
design.within_state_measurements: four branches and all twelve ordered recipient-to-donor pairs
